purpose: Pins the chart store and the postflop open-node store by content identity for Horse decisions whose journal record carries only a row count (every release before the store identity was journaled, including the serving release e6b9dc5d). A decision is matched to a pin only if it was made inside the window by a release committed inside the window, whose worker cannot therefore have loaded its store before the window opened.
